<?php
// search.php - 商品搜索接口
// 框架：Express (PHP 模拟路由)
// 场景：用户搜索商品，使用 MongoDB 聚合管道

class ProductSearchController {
    private $db;
    
    public function __construct($mongoClient) {
        $this->db = $mongoClient->selectDatabase('shop');
    }
    
    // 路由: GET /api/search?q=keyword&category=electronics
    public function search($request, $response) {
        // 第1行：获取用户输入
        $keyword = $request->query['q'] ?? '';
        $category = $request->query['category'] ?? '';
        
        // 第5行：白名单校验 - 只允许字母数字和空格
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9\s]{1,50}$/', $keyword)) {
            return $response->json(['error' => 'Invalid keyword format'], 400);
        }
        
        // 第9行：类别白名单 - 防注入迷惑点
        $allowedCategories = ['electronics', 'books', 'clothing', 'home'];
        if (!in_array($category, $allowedCategories, true)) {
            $category = 'all'; // 非白名单值回退到默认
        }
        
        // 第14行：使用参数化查询（MongoDB 聚合管道）
        $pipeline = [];
        
        // 第16行：构建匹配条件 - 使用转义但无实际注入风险
        $matchCondition = [];
        if ($category !== 'all') {
            $matchCondition['category'] = $category; // 直接赋值，白名单已验证
        }
        
        // 第21行：关键词搜索 - 使用正则但经过严格白名单
        if (!empty($keyword)) {
            // 转义正则特殊字符（防御迷惑：看起来像replace转义）
            $escapedKeyword = preg_replace('/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/', '\\$&', $keyword);
            $matchCondition['name'] = new MongoDB\BSON\Regex('^' . $escapedKeyword, 'i');
        }
        
        // 第27行：添加聚合管道阶段
        if (!empty($matchCondition)) {
            $pipeline[] = ['$match' => $matchCondition];
        }
        
        // 第31行：限制返回字段
        $pipeline[] = ['$project' => [
            'name' => 1,
            'price' => 1,
            'category' => 1,
            '_id' => 0
        ]];
        
        // 第36行：排序和分页
        $pipeline[] = ['$sort' => ['price' => 1]];
        $pipeline[] = ['$limit' => 20];
        
        // 第40行：执行查询
        try {
            $products = $this->db->selectCollection('products')
                ->aggregate($pipeline)->toArray();
            return $response->json(['data' => $products], 200);
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            // 第45行：异常处理 - 不暴露内部错误
            error_log('Search error: ' . $e->getMessage());
            return $response->json(['error' => 'Search failed'], 500);
        }
    }
}

# .gitlab-ci.yml
stages:
  - deploy

variables:
  NGINX_CONF_PATH: "/etc/nginx/conf.d/reverse-proxy.conf"
  # 敏感信息通过 CI/CD 变量注入，不硬编码在仓库中
  UPSTREAM_HOST: "internal-backend:8080"
  TLS_CERT_PATH: "/etc/nginx/certs/server.crt"
  TLS_KEY_PATH: "/etc/nginx/certs/server.key"

deploy_reverse_proxy:
  stage: deploy
  image: nginx:1.25-alpine
  before_script:
    - apk add --no-cache openssl
  script:
    # 使用受保护变量（在 GitLab 中标记为 protected），仅对受保护分支可用
    - echo "Deploying reverse proxy with TLS 1.3 only"
    # 生成临时自签名证书用于演示（生产环境应用用受管 CA 证书）
    - openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 365 -newkey rsa:2048 \
        -keyout /tmp/server.key -out /tmp/server.crt \
        -subj "/CN=api.example.com"
    # 将证书复制到 nginx 容器挂载目录（由运维在 runner 上以最小权限挂载）
    - cp /tmp/server.crt /tmp/server.key ${TLS_CERT_PATH} ${TLS_KEY_PATH}
    # 使用环境变量动态生成 nginx 配置，避免硬编码内部 IP
    - cat > ${NGINX_CONF_PATH} <<EOF
      server {
          listen 443 ssl;
          # 仅启用 TLS 1.3，禁用旧协议
          ssl_protocols TLSv1.3;
          ssl_ciphers 'TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256:TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384';
          ssl_certificate ${TLS_CERT_PATH};
          ssl_certificate_key ${TLS_KEY_PATH};

          location / {
              proxy_pass http://${UPSTREAM_HOST};
              # 限制上游响应头，防止信息泄露
              proxy_hide_header X-Powered-By;
          }
      }
      EOF
    # 以非 root 用户运行 nginx（nginx 官方镜像默认用户为 nginx）
    - nginx -t -c ${NGINX_CONF_PATH}
    - nginx -s reload
  only:
    - main
  environment:
    name: production

// TemplateRenderer.php - 原生PHP模板渲染组件
class TemplateRenderer {
    private $templateDir;
    private $session;
    
    public function __construct($templateDir, $session) {
        $this->templateDir = rtrim($templateDir, '/');
        $this->session = $session;
    }
    
    // 渲染用户请求的模板
    public function render($templateName) {
        // 第4行：强制登录检查
        if (!$this->session->isAuthenticated()) {
            throw new Exception('Unauthorized access', 401);
        }
        
        // 第8行：模板名白名单验证
        $allowedTemplates = ['home', 'profile', 'settings', 'dashboard'];
        if (!in_array($templateName, $allowedTemplates, true)) {
            throw new Exception('Template not allowed', 403);
        }
        
        // 第13行：路径规范化（防止路径穿越）
        $basePath = realpath($this->templateDir);
        $fullPath = realpath($this->templateDir . '/' . $templateName . '.php');
        
        if ($fullPath === false || strpos($fullPath, $basePath) !== 0) {
            throw new Exception('Invalid template path', 400);
        }
        
        // 第19行：仅渲染白名单内的文件
        $content = file_get_contents($fullPath);
        return $this->renderContent($content);
    }
    
    private function renderContent($content) {
        // 第24行：使用htmlspecialchars转义所有输出
        return htmlspecialchars($content, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
    }
}

// 使用示例
$session = new SessionManager();
$renderer = new TemplateRenderer('/var/www/templates', $session);

// 用户请求处理
if (isset($_GET['page'])) {
    $page = $_GET['page'];
    
    // 第35行：输入过滤（去除危险字符）
    $page = str_replace(['../', '..\\', '/'], '', $page);
    
    try {
        echo $renderer->render($page);
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        http_response_code($e->getCode());
        echo 'Error: ' . $e->getMessage();
    }
}

import os
from flask import Flask, request, send_file, session, abort
from werkzeug.utils import secure_filename

app = Flask(__name__)
app.secret_key = 'super-secret-key'

EXPORT_DIR = '/data/exports'

@app.route('/export/<filename>')
def export_file(filename):
    # 模拟会话校验
    if not session.get('user_id'):
        abort(401)

    # 防御迷惑：replace 去除"../"，但仅替换一次
    sanitized = filename.replace('../', '', 1)

    # 防御迷惑：startswith 检查，但未规范化
    full_path = os.path.join(EXPORT_DIR, sanitized)

    if not full_path.startswith(EXPORT_DIR):
        abort(403)

    # 最终防御：使用 secure_filename 白名单
    safe_name = secure_filename(sanitized)

    if safe_name != sanitized:
        abort(400)

    full_path = os.path.join(EXPORT_DIR, safe_name)

    if not os.path.isfile(full_path):
        abort(404)

    return send_file(full_path)

// routes/api.php - Express-like API route for user profile rendering

use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\TemplateService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;

class ProfileController extends Controller
{
    private $templateService;

    public function __construct(TemplateService $templateService)
    {
        $this->templateService = $templateService;
    }

    public function renderProfile(Request $request, $userId)
    {
        // 1. Validate user ID is numeric (whitelist pattern)
        $validator = Validator::make(['userId' => $userId], [
            'userId' => 'required|integer|min:1|max:999999'
        ]);

        if ($validator->fails()) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Invalid user ID'], 400);
        }

        // 2. Fetch user from DB (parameterized query via Eloquent)
        $user = User::find($userId);
        if (!$user) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'User not found'], 404);
        }

        // 3. User-provided template name from request body
        $templateName = $request->input('template', 'default_profile');

        // 4. Defense: whitelist allowed template names
        $allowedTemplates = [
            'default_profile' => 'profiles/default.twig',
            'premium_profile' => 'profiles/premium.twig',
            'admin_profile'    => 'profiles/admin.twig'
        ];

        // 5. Defense: strict key lookup - no direct path concatenation
        if (!array_key_exists($templateName, $allowedTemplates)) {
            // 6. Fallback to default template instead of error (reduces info leak)
            $templateName = 'default_profile';
        }

        // 7. Defense: normalize path using realpath and ensure it's within templates dir
        $templatePath = $allowedTemplates[$templateName];
        $baseDir = realpath(base_path('resources/views'));
        $fullPath = realpath(base_path('resources/views') . '/' . $templatePath);

        // 8. Defense: verify resolved path is inside base directory
        if ($fullPath === false || strpos($fullPath, $baseDir) !== 0) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Template access denied'], 403);
        }

        // 9. Render with Twig (auto-escapes output, no eval)
        $html = $this->templateService->render(
            $templatePath,
            ['user' => $user->toArray()]
        );

        return response()->json(['html' => $html]);
    }
}
